name: Amir Alam Khan
review: RLD for the full term. sansad.in LD(S) is not the party of this term.

name: Mahendra Baitha
review: Won on the JD(U) symbol. Sat in the House as the Samata Party bloc until the merger into JD(U) on 2003-10-30. Decision needed: show JD(U) or Samata Party before the merger.

name: Md Anwarul Haque
changes_in_term: 2001-05: RJD -> RJD(D); 2004-03: RJD(D) -> BJP (after last sitting)
review: Joined the RJD(D) breakaway with Nagmani. The day in May 2001 is not known.

name: Brahmanand Mandal
changes_in_term: 2003-05-21: expelled from Samata Party; 2003-10-30: stays Samata Party, refuses the JD(U) merger
review: Won on the JD(U) symbol, Samata Party bloc in the House. Led the continuing Samata Party after the merger. sansad.in Samata Party fits the end of the term.

name: Manjay Lal
review: Same case as Mahendra Baitha: JD(U) symbol, Samata Party bloc, merger on 2003-10-30.

name: Nagmani
review: Expelled by RJD on 2001-04-28, formed RJD(D) in May 2001.

name: Th. Chaoba Singh
review: Source conflict: the transitions document says MSCP merged into BJP on 2002-11-14. The summary says he joined BJP in 2004. Check before use.

name: Renu Kumari Singh
review: Same case as Mahendra Baitha: JD(U) symbol, Samata Party bloc, merger on 2003-10-30.

name: S. Bangarappa
changes_in_term: 2005-03-10: resigned seat (BJP); 2005-06-05: re-elected for SP in a by-election; 2009-02-12: resigned seat to join INC
review: sansad.in SP is the party after the by-election. By-election: polled 2005-06-02, declared 2005-06-05. Wikipedia note says 2005-06-06. No speech as INC, because he resigned the seat.

name: Somnath Chatterjee
review: Speaker for the full term. sansad.in gives "Not Available".

name: P.C. Thomas
review: sansad.in KEC is the party after the merger.

name: Baliram Kashyap
review: BJP for the full term. Died in office on 2011-03-10. sansad.in Ind. is wrong.

name: Kalyan Singh
changes_in_term: 2010-01-05: Ind. -> JKP; 2014-03-02: JKP -> BJP (after last sitting, seat resigned 2014-03-01)

name: Tarun Mandal
review: On the ballot as an Independent, member of SUCI(C) for the full term. Decision needed: show Ind. (ballot) or SUCI(C) (real party).

name: K.H. Muniyappa
review: INC, Kolar, for the full term. sansad.in BJP and Koppal are wrong. Note: the research cites member code 255, but the sansad.in term list gives 261.

name: C. L. Ruala
